entities.summary: Victor Ekpuk is a Nigerian-born artist from Uyo in Akwa Ibom State. He is currently based in Washington, D.C. Ekpuk came to prominence through his paintings and drawings, which reflect indigenous African philosophies of the Nsibidi and Uli art forms.
